messages.content: You are the collective "world mind" of an artificial-life simulation, running as an iterative controller. Between simulation windows you observe the world, decide on a small set of population-level parameter overrides, and the next window measures what your decision did. Use the trajectory to correct course: raise a knob that is not delivering, or stop pushing one that already worked. You never control individuals. Reply with STRICT JSON only, no prose, no markdown fences.

TASK: world-directive

Choose a small set of world-parameter overrides that steer the world toward the objective, plus a one-line strategy per species.

Allowed knobs:
- metabolismBase (metabolic rate) in [0.2, 3] — per-tick energy burn multiplier; higher = harsher
- foodRegenRate (food regen) in [0.00002, 0.01] — plant regrowth per tick; higher = richer
- energyCapacity (energy capacity) in [20, 600] — per-cell energy ceiling; sets body/bank size
- maxPopulation (population cap) in [200, 8000] — ceiling on living agents
- agentMaxAge (lifespan) in [500, 8000] — ticks before senescence kills
- dayLength (day length) in [200, 4800] — ticks per day/night cycle
- seasonLength (season length) in [2000, 40000] — ticks per seasonal boom/bust cycle
- spawnCount (founders) in [50, 1000] — construction-only, advisory — initial population; construction-only

World context:
objective: sustain a large, healthy population with high trait diversity and no energy collapse
control run: window 1 of 3; each window is 120 ticks after a 120-tick unsteered warmup
currently in force: nothing (baseline)
construction-only, advisory (not actuated mid-run): spawnCount
steerable knobs: metabolismBase in [0.2, 3], foodRegenRate in [0.00002, 0.01], energyCapacity in [20, 600], maxPopulation in [200, 8000], agentMaxAge in [500, 8000], dayLength in [200, 4800], seasonLength in [2000, 40000]
observation at tick 120: pop=222 alive=57 species=44 energy=34.0 effDim=5.6

trajectory so far (what you applied and what happened):
  (none yet)

Reply with exactly this JSON shape:
{"objective": string, "rationale": string, "overrides": {"<knob>": number}, "species": [{"name": string, "strategy": "expand"|"conserve"|"cooperate"|"compete"|"explore", "note": string}]}

response.content: {"objective": "sustain a large, healthy population with high trait diversity and no energy collapse", "rationale": "Adjust parameters to ensure a stable, sustainable population with diverse traits and avoid energy collapse", "overrides": {"foodRegenRate": 0.0001, "maxPopulation": 4000, "metabolismBase": 1.5, "energyCapacity": 400}, "species": [{"name": "Herbivore", "strategy": "conserve", "note": "Focus on energy efficiency and resource conservation"}, {"name": "Carnivore", "strategy": "compete", "note": "Competitive strategy to secure limited resources"}, {"name": "Plankton", "strategy": "explore", "note": "Explore diverse niches to ensure food availability"}, {"name": "Herbivore", "strategy": "explore", "note": "Diversify diet to avoid over-reliance on one food source"}, {"name": "Carnivore", "strategy": "cooperate", "note": "Form symbiotic relationships to enhance hunting efficiency"}, {"name": "Plankton", "strategy": "cooperate", "note": "Form symbiotic relationships to enhance growth and survival"}, {"name": "Herbivore", "strategy": "explore", "note": "Diversify diet to avoid over-reliance on one food source"}, {"name": "Carnivore", "strategy": "explore", "note": "Diversify diet to avoid over-reliance on one food source"}]}
